Threadforge 1.0.24 is smaller and more focused. Several tools now live in the separate ThreadFactory desktop app, and the in-app browser is gone.

- **Links open in Comet.** The in-app Browser, Visual Fix and the Preview pane are removed. Web links and agents' `open_browser` requests open in Comet, or in the default browser when Comet is not installed. Comet starts with a minimal environment.
- **Updates.** The "Browser & Updates" settings page is now "Updates". Self-update works as before, and the daily-check switch sits on the same row as its label.
- **Moved to ThreadFactory.** Security Station, the Database explorer, the project file tree, Canvas and the task Kanban board are now in ThreadFactory. Threadforge keeps the Progression view and the Agent sidebar; the Dashboard has three tabs: Status, Progression and Chat.
- **Forge bridge.** A local, token-protected HTTP API lets ThreadFactory read workspaces, agent file activity and tasks. It can also send text to a coding agent, open a file or focus a pane, run, retry or stop team tasks and plans, and accept or reject proposed changes. ThreadFactory asks for confirmation before it runs, stops or removes a task or applies a proposed change.
- **Provider icon.** The Hermes Agent provider uses its official artwork.

Old data from the removed features stays on disk and is not migrated or deleted: browser profile and saved passwords, Security Station runs, saved database connections and Canvas history.

The installer is about half the size of 1.0.23. Windows x64 NSIS installer with matching updater and checksum assets. Installed provider and UI acceptance follows the owner's manual testing.

The Toolbox ZIP contains the application payload from the original release above, without rebuilding or running it. Install it through Thread Toolbox; the original downloads are also retained.

# ThreadNote 0.1.1

ThreadNote now uses the approved Thread Space v1.0 gold `TN` icon throughout the
application and its Windows packages. Startup keeps the existing animation and
4.4-second timing, with the decorative sparks removed.

## Changes

- Replaced the application/menu/About/empty-state mark, startup logo, favicon,
  window/tray/shortcut icon, and installer/uninstaller icon resources.
- Added an outlined SVG master, transparent 16–1024px PNG exports and a multi-size
  Windows ICO. Builds reject stale icon exports.
- Restricted Windows packaging to production bundles so old local smoke-test
  screenshots and logs are excluded.
- Preserved navigation pictograms, configurable interface themes and user-selected
  workspace icons. AEGIS assets and code are unchanged.

## Downloads

- **Threadnote-0.1.1-setup.exe**: Windows x64 installer.
- **Threadnote-0.1.1-portable.exe**: standalone Windows x64 executable.
- **SHA256SUMS.txt**: SHA-256 checksums for the binaries and installer metadata.

Installed builds keep notes under `%APPDATA%/threadnote/` by default. Portable
builds use `ThreadnoteData` beside the executable. Settings → Data can select
another location. These builds use the project's existing unsigned configuration.

## Validation

- 528 tests passed across 58 test files; ESLint, TypeScript and production builds
  passed. All generated brand resources match the SVG master.
- The packaged version is 0.1.1. All 19 production build/migration files and the
  runtime ICO match their sources; old smoke-test outputs are excluded.
- Application, installer and portable executable resources contain all seven TN
  icon frames and report product version 0.1.1.0.
- Installer metadata sizes/SHA-512 and downloadable SHA-256 checksums are verified.

Native desktop UI checks are excluded by the browser-only verification policy.

# ThreadVoice v0.1.1

Windows x64 maintenance release with the Thread Space brand update and corrected startup navigation.

## Changes

- Adopted the approved Thread Space v1.0 **TV** monogram and **#7548F6** violet palette in the
  control panel, floating widget, startup screen, window/tray icons, setup and uninstaller.
- Replaced the old glow and waveform artwork with a transparent geometric mark; updated startup
  animation artwork and removed decorative sparks, preserving the 4.4-second intro, Skip intro and
  reduced-motion behavior.
- Startup now opens **Home**, including when the API key is missing or the keyboard hook is unavailable.
  Settings remains available through explicit navigation.
- Added a vector master and reproducible PNG/ICO exports, resource checks and focused startup regressions.
- Removed obsolete brand artwork from incremental builds.

## Install or update

Download **ThreadVoice-Setup-0.1.1.exe** and run the installer. It installs for the current user and
creates desktop and Start menu shortcuts. Node.js is bundled. Installing over v0.1.0 preserves settings
and history. Configure your OpenAI API key in **Settings → Connection** if needed.

The installer is unsigned. Dictation and voice conversations require an internet connection and your
own paid OpenAI API access. Uninstalling preserves settings and history.

## Validation

- All 155 automated tests passed, including startup and animation regression coverage.
- TypeScript type checking and generated brand-resource checks passed.
- A fresh Windows x64 NSIS installer was built successfully; emitted and packaged brand-resource
  checks passed. The packaged app contains version 0.1.1 and the corrected Home startup route.
- Installer/app executable versions, update-metadata file size and SHA-512 checksum were verified.
  Release assets include the installer, blockmap, update metadata and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Full interactive UI verification remains incomplete because the agent's in-app browser timed out.
No desktop UI was automated.

ThreadAccount 0.5.2 Usage-ს სამ ახალ ხედს უმატებს — Pace, Spiral და Bursts — და Dashboard-ის Weekly rhythm-ს უფრო კომპაქტურს ხდის.

- Usage → **Pace** (`#pace`): ყველა ანგარიშის მთავარი ფანჯარა ერთ ღერძზე, Window start-იდან Reset-მდე, **Even pace** დიაგონალთან შედარებით. ტემპი = გამოყენებული წილი / გასული დროის წილი (მაგ. 48%-ში 72% = 1.5x). წყვეტილი ხაზი „If the pace holds“: ამოწურვა (წითელი წერტილი, „Runs out Thu 22:58“), დაშტრიხული ბლოკირება ან reset-ზე პროგნოზირებული %. მარჯვნივ: Used now, Even pace by now, Runs out / Locked before reset და „All accounts · fastest first“. **Past windows** არჩეული ანგარიშის წინა ფანჯრებს იმავე ღერძზე ადებს.
- Usage → Weeks → **Spiral**: ერთი ბრუნი = ერთი კვირის ფანჯარა, ყველაზე ძველი შიგნით. საათობრივი უჯრები დახარჯული pp-ის მიხედვითაა შეფერილი, ჩანს ბლოკირება, reset, ამოწურვები კვირების მიხედვით, პროგნოზი და ჩვეული საათები. ცენტრში წერია, რამდენით ადრე ამოიწურება ლიმიტი. არჩეული კვირის პანელში: მრუდი, Ran out / Locked / Usual hours locked და Use per day.
- Usage → **Bursts** (`#bursts`): **Drum**-ში ბოლო 29 დღე დღეების მიხედვით ჩანს. Burst არის საათების მიმდევრობა, სადაც თითოეულ საათში 2.4 pp ან მეტი დაიხარჯა. მოინიშნება ბლოკირება, ამოწურვა და reset; სათაური ამბობს, რა წილი მოდის burst-ებზე და ემთხვევა თუ არა ისინი სხვა ანგარიშის ბლოკირებას. **Catalog** burst-ებს ცხრილად აჩვენებს. არჩეული burst-ის პანელში: დღის საათობრივი გრაფიკი, Burst size / Duration / Share of week და Use per week.
- Dashboard → **Weekly rhythm**: 13px კვადრატული უჯრები, როგორც Usage-ის quota კალენდარში; მწკრივის ბოლოს დღის წილი, ფართო პანელში სტატისტიკა მარჯვნივ (Peak hour, Active slots). Tooltip უჯრას მიჰყვება და ქვედა მწკრივებში ზემოთ იხსნება.
- ყველა ახალი გრაფიკი ინტერაქტიულია: hover/ფოკუსი, tooltip, ისრები, Enter არჩევისთვის, Escape.

ინსტალერი: `npm.cmd run dist` → `release/ThreadAccount-0.5.2-Setup.exe` (მიმდინარე მომხმარებლისთვის, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ThreadAccount`).

შემოწმება: 67 JavaScript და 29 Rust ტესტი, 35 ბრაუზერის და 15 Dashboard სცენარი; Pace, Spiral და Bursts ბრაუზერში sample მონაცემებით (მაუსი და კლავიატურა). Desktop smoke ტესტი ამ ვერსიაზე არ გაშვებულა.

ThreadAura 0.1.0 is the first Windows x64 release of the local live-wallpaper studio.

### Included

- Image/video library, favorites, portable projects and file-based gallery sharing.
- Independent displays, span/duplicate, playlists, schedules, tray controls and optional startup/session restore.
- Scene layers, keyframes, particles, audio response, local depth parallax and silent WebM export.
- Puppet Warp, OBJ/FBX/GLB, custom GLSL, isolated JavaScript and self-contained HTML wallpapers.
- Optional now-playing information, Razer Chroma and Corsair iCUE integrations.
- AI website workflows, saved ChatGPT requests and optional native OpenAI API generation.

### Gaming memory saving

**Settings → Desktop playback → Free wallpaper memory while gaming** defaults on. Fullscreen or configured foreground-app rules close wallpaper renderers on all displays. They return after two stable seconds, preserving playlist position, countdown, Shuffle history and manual Pause. Videos and scene animations restart. Studio and native scene/playlist snapshots remain allocated.

### Downloads

- `ThreadAura_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe`: Windows installer.
- `ThreadAura-0.1.0-win32-x64.zip`: portable application, also used by ThreadBox.
- `toolbox-manifest.json`: verified ThreadBox package metadata.
- `SHA256SUMS`: SHA-256 checksums for the installer, ZIP and manifest.

Requires Windows 10/11 x64 and Microsoft WebView2. Local depth assets are embedded; no model download is required after installation. AI website services and the optional API have their own account requirements and limits.

### Validation and current limits

139 frontend tests, 57 Rust tests, Clippy and production Windows NSIS packaging passed. Browser settings verification passed. The application and installer were not launched during these checks; native Windows playback, hardware integrations and actual gaming RAM/VRAM savings remain manually unverified.

Steam Workshop, Wallpaper Engine scene-package compatibility, Android and screensavers are not included.

Threaduninstal v0.3.0 is a rewrite in Rust (Tauri 2) with a React interface in the ThreadFactory design. It no longer needs .NET Framework or PowerShell.

- **Application icons in the list.** Every row of Applications and Windows Apps shows the program's own icon, extracted at the screen's pixel size from its DisplayIcon, MSI product icon, executable, uninstaller or Start Menu shortcut. 0.2 only loaded the icon of the selected application.
- **Uninstallers that hand off to a temporary copy** (Inno Setup, NSIS) are followed until every helper process has exited, so the leftover scan no longer starts while the uninstaller is still open.
- New: optional System Restore point before uninstalling, Junk Files cleaner, Windows Tools, deleting backups and installation logs, HTML export, recent/large filters, sorting, keyboard navigation, system components on request, registry key in Registry Editor, publisher links and web search, measured size when the registry has none, Task Manager startup state, Hunter Mode for Store app windows.
- Windows Apps are read and removed through the Windows PackageManager API (fast, no PowerShell) and show their logos.
- Unchanged safety rules: exact product matching, no links or junctions, recovery manifests before the first move, no overwriting of newer data on restore. Backups, installation logs and disabled startup entries from 0.2 are read as before.

## Downloads

- **Threaduninstal-v0.3.0.zip**: portable app (`Threaduninstal.exe`, `assets/app.ico`, README, licences). This is the ThreadBox package.
- **Threaduninstal-v0.3.0.exe**: the same executable on its own.
- **SHA256SUMS.txt**: SHA-256 checksums of both.

Requires 64-bit Windows 10/11 with WebView2. Portable; no installer, account or network connection. Close 0.2 before opening 0.3.

## Validation

41 Rust tests (matching, scans, backups and restore, junctions, registry snapshots, startup, monitor, Hunter matching, icon extraction, command parsing), TypeScript typecheck, and a read-only run on a real machine: 120 of 131 desktop programs show their own icon in the window; the rest ship no icon at all. Uninstalling, cleanup and restore were exercised on test fixtures, not on installed programs.

# Threadplan 1.0.0

First GitHub release of Threadplan for Windows x64 and Android: offline tasks, habits, calendar and JSON backups with the shared redesigned interface.

## Downloads

- **Windows installer:** `Threadplan-1.0.0-windows-x64-setup.exe`. Installs for the current user and downloads Microsoft Edge WebView2 if it is missing.
- **Windows portable:** `Threadplan-1.0.0-windows-x64-portable.zip`. Extract and run `Threadplan.exe`; WebView2 must already be installed.
- **Android:** `Threadplan-1.0.0-android-preview.apk`. Android 7.0/API 24 or newer; ARM64 and x86_64; package `com.threadplan.app`, version 1.0.0, build 10.
- **Checksums:** `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all three packages.

Windows binaries are unsigned development builds. Android is a release-mode build signed with the existing local preview/debug key; it is not a Play Store submission.

## Included

- Tasks with notes, priorities, categories, date/time scheduling, recurrence, search, filters, completion and restore; Today and calendar views.
- Habits with schedules, quantitative goals, history, streaks and statistics.
- Local English/Georgian quick-add parsing with an editable review form.
- Android task/habit reminders, reminder diagnostics and Today/Habits home-screen widgets.
- Windows Tauri 2/Rust shell with native SQLite and reviewed JSON backup import/export.
- Shared appearance settings: themes, text size, button/navigation/icon colors, local background images, six background effects, opacity, blur, glass and interface scale.
- Optional Windows ThreadVoice task dictation using the existing ThreadVoice profile and the user's OpenAI API account. Android voice input uses an installed on-device model.

## Data and upgrades

Windows retains `com.threadplan.desktop` and stores its database at `%APPDATA%\com.threadplan.desktop\threadplan.db`. Schema 8 and existing forward migrations are preserved. No database reset or new migration was introduced for this release.

Export a JSON backup before moving between installations. Existing Electron/browser profiles remain in their original storage; transfer through the reviewed JSON import flow. JSON import replaces records after confirmation. Backups are not encrypted. Android OS automatic backup is disabled.

## Validation and limits

Source commit: `1ab097ffd214513bae6d70614dc56c5672cf69bd`.

Release validation includes TypeScript, ESLint, 121 shared tests, 9 Rust tests, 2 Windows native SQLite integration tests, 2 Android widget JVM tests, web/Android exports, Windows installer build and Android APK build/signature verification.

Native WebView2 launch, installer/dialog interaction, Android launch/widget/reminder delivery, physical-device behavior and real-microphone transcription remain unverified for this release under the project's browser-only UI rule. Windows reminder delivery, notification navigation, background scheduling and offline speech remain pending. Interface labels remain English; there is no cloud sync.

# ThreadLibrary 0.1.1

Fixes the Windows startup failure after installing ThreadLibrary 0.1.0. The installer and Toolbox ZIP now include the local server's required production dependencies, including Express.

- Install or update through Thread Toolbox, or use `ThreadLibrary-Setup-0.1.1.exe`.
- Existing registered projects and transfer history remain in the per-user profile.
- The package includes Node and all 1,014 library resources; no source checkout or separate Node installation is required.

Validation: 25 unit/runtime tests, TypeScript and the production build passed. The shipped HTTP service and MCP handshake/search passed outside the source checkout with a fresh profile. All 17,173 installer/ZIP payload files and 2,652 reference blobs were verified. The desktop UI and installer were not executed during verification.

CI traces on the Actions page.

## Highlights

- **Run waterfall:** an expanded run shows its jobs and steps as time bars on one axis. The runner queue wait is shown separately from execution. Clicking a step opens that step's log.
- **Failure reasons:** failed runs open with a summary. Check-run annotations are listed as `path:line` with their level, and each one links to the failing step's log.
- **CI insights:** with one workflow selected, the Insights view shows the p50/p95 run duration trend, failure rate, slowest jobs and steps, and queue time. It shows how many API requests it used and how much rate limit is left. When data is partial, it says so and offers Retry.

## Notes

- Everything comes from the GitHub API with your existing token. No new dependencies.
- GitHub job logs have no step markers, so log lines are assigned to steps by timestamp. A line exactly on a step boundary can land in the next step.
